scope: Proposition 9.6 (Fixed-buffer Jordan comparison) of the manuscript “Cardy’s formula for critical Poisson–Voronoi percolation” (preprints/Cardys-formula-for-critical-Poisson-Voronoi-percolation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 224 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1334302b31272ae0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 71. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let D be any bounded Jordan domain with distinct positively ordered boundary marks a, b, c, d. For the full-plane Poisson tessellation with independent fair cell colors, the annealed probability of a connected crossing in the closed black-cell union intersected with D, from ab to cd, converges to C(x) with the marked conformal parameter of D.
